title: Member Mail Catalog Orders Paid from the OTC Allowance
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — over-the-counter (OTC) allowance, mail catalog.** When a member asks to put her over-the-counter allowance toward a mail catalog order, the catalog order allowance is the part of the allowance balance the order may use.

### When the allowance applied is fixed

The allowance applied to a catalog order is fixed only after every retail receipt transmitted for the current quarter carries a posting date.

The current quarter is the calendar quarter that contains today. So long as the allowance activity shows a retail receipt of the current quarter that has been transmitted but carries no posting date, the allowance applied to a catalog order is not yet fixed.

### Business effect

The order records one mail catalog purchase on the member's pharmacy coverage, tagged with the quarter and dated the day it is placed, issues an order number, and lowers the coverage's current allowance balance by the allowance amount applied to the order; the catalog items beyond that amount are the member's own cost. Afterwards the member has an order number and sees the order in her allowance activity.

### How it is invoked

This is the member's own action. The agent unlocks the tool `place_otc_catalog_order_ca6274ae` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it to place the order.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rx_coverage_id` | The reference number of the member's pharmacy coverage record, as the member services representative reads it from the pharmacy coverage lookup | Identifier, as shown by the lookup |
| `benefit_quarter` | The calendar quarter the order is charged to | YYYY-Qn (for example 2026-Q3) |
| `allowance_amount` | The allowance applied to the order | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places; a value with more places is rounded to 2 decimal places |

### Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of `order_number` (the catalog order number issued), `rx_otc_id` (the reference number of the purchase entry), `allowance_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `otc_balance` (the allowance balance after the order, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status` (the text "ordered", which confirms the order was placed).

### Contract note

*What does the member pay?* The catalog items beyond the allowance amount applied are the member's own cost.
